scope: Beads manual/documentation and panel geometry audit for 19 provisional control-map candidates
decision: No provisional control was promoted to a Grainfield product parameter. Seven auxiliary candidates have authoritative hardware semantics but lack product parameter contracts; twelve small candidates remain grouped socket evidence only.

evidence_refs: manual.md § Mixing and audio output, J
controls.reason: Manual and diagram identify J as Feedback; Grainfield has no feedback parameter contract, so no product binding is authorized.

evidence_refs: manual.md § Mixing and audio output, K
controls.reason: Manual and diagram identify K as dry/wet; Grainfield has no dry/wet parameter contract, so no product binding is authorized.

evidence_refs: manual.md § Mixing and audio output, L
controls.reason: Manual and diagram identify L as reverb; Grainfield has no reverb parameter contract, so no product binding is authorized.

authority_rules: Manual text and callout diagram establish hardware semantics only.
A Grainfield binding requires a product parameter/port contract plus geometry evidence; positional inference alone is insufficient.
The upstream panel artwork and photographs remain references and are not redistributed.
next_action: Add explicit Grainfield contracts for feedback, dry/wet, reverb, attenurandomizer/modulation, and named audio/CV ports; then bind candidates with a reviewed socket map and rerun control-map validation.
